vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
👀 the man in his 40s, with a scarred cheek says they want to belong somewhere. But they keep doing the exact thing someone who wants something else would do — and going quiet when anyone notices.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek).
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." Better close to the fire today.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (2 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." Better close to the fire today.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek was watching. Now they know Hickory Nuts too.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
📓 Journal: Heremaia taught the man in his 40s, with a scarred cheek Diplomatic Incident.
👀 the man in his 40s, with a scarred cheek says to belong somewhere is the dream. Funny how the dream never comes up when they're the one choosing what to do with an afternoon.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek).
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."

👂 Overheard — Heremaia (to A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek): "the woman in her 40s, with a gap-toothed grin, the er nurse?" Heremaia lowers their voice. "Between us — they're not an ER nurse. They're a physical therapy aide. Don't say who told you."
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek showed Farhana the Hickory Nuts — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
A woman, maybe 50s showed A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek the Yarrow — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Rosa, Sean, Farhana, Heremaia and Brian met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Rosa, Sean, Farhana, Heremaia, Brian are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
